node.title: RF3-double-prime retained-degree KoalaBear safe rows
node.statement: The corrected global-degree RF3-double-prime factor lift, combined with retained-degree interpolation, unconditionally bounds the full-field MCA bad-slope numerator at four n=2^21 KoalaBear rows by 274589064742753629, 274721012201293956, 274578888391562205, and 274861787390263486 respectively, each at most floor(p_KB^6/2^128)=274980728111395087. Thus the printed agreements 1485170, 1051719, 744762, and 527408 are safe at rates 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, and 1/16. No adjacent unsafe packet or maximal radius is claimed.
